instruction: On the FlightAware community forum, open any discussion thread.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter 'active_url_from_accessTree' correctly extracts the active tab URL from Chrome's accessibility tree, which is the right state to check for URL-based navigation tasks.

Metric 'is_expected_url_pattern_match' correctly uses regex to verify the URL matches 'https://discussions\.flightaware\.com/t/', which precisely identifies a Discourse forum thread page (FlightAware's community forum uses /t/ prefix for individual thread URLs).
Parameter handling is correct: expected.type='rule' causes the framework to pass the rules dict directly, and the metric accesses rules['expected'] without any incorrect nested key lookup.

Full instruction coverage: instruction requires opening 'any discussion thread', and the evaluator checks for a thread-level URL pattern (not just the forum homepage), which is sufficient and correct.
Negative control resistance: initial state starts at www.flightaware.com which does not match discussions.flightaware.com/t/ so the evaluator will correctly score 0.0 at baseline.
